text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: With the spring of the Senior Class behind her, Twin Turbo—

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text: Heh-heh-heh. Trainer, Turbo got super-duper strong, didn't she?

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Teio said at the press conference the other day
that she could "run to the ends of the earth,"
but Turbo...

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text: I can dive all the way down to the bottom of the sea, you know!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Her comparison felt a bit off, but seeing her gain confidence was wonderful.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Twin Turbo is doing just fine.
On the other hand, the situation around her is...

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Aah... Finishing in 5th place definitely feels
like too big of a loss, but still...

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Now that I can finally run!
Next time at the Takarazuka Kinen, I'll definitely...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Tokai Teio has finally emerged from her long layoff
and is regaining her former brilliance.
And then—

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Aaah, who would've thought I'd be the one
taking a break, swapping places with Teio...

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Terrible timing, as usual.

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Ah, Nature!
You can't race yet?

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, looks like I won't be able to for a while.
It's kind of... inflamed, you see.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
I'm gonna take it easy until autumn,
so give it your all in the meantime, Turbo!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Yeah! Hey, hey, Trainer.
Isn't it about time?

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text: Teio's finally back like we've been waiting for, so it's about time for our fated showdown!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Teio, huh. Come to think of it, I heard Team Teio
was going to make some kind of announcement today.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
I wonder if she's going to officially announce that she's heading for the Takarazuka Kinen.
Things might get noisy again.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Tokai Teio had returned to the center of the Twinkle Series, but—

text_block_list.name: Teio's Medical Staff
text_block_list.text:
Unfortunately, we have decided to
pass on the Takarazuka Kinen. The reason being—

text_block_list.name: Teio's Medical Staff
text_block_list.text:
"It's a fracture, once again.
As for her prospects of returning..."

text_block_list.name: Teio's Medical Staff
text_block_list.text:
It will likely be in autumn or later.
I'm sorry, let's leave it at this for today...

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
"A fracture... Again, huh?
Again, Teio? But still..."

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Autumn might be just perfect! Nature should
be back by then, too!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Turbo... You say that, but...

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
I wonder if Trainer's alright?
I mean, after what happened last time, too...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
What caught my attention were the words and actions
of Teio's camp during the press conference.

text_block_list.name: Teio's Medical Staff
text_block_list.text:
It will likely be in autumn or later.
I'm sorry, let's leave it at this for today...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"From autumn onward." There is no deep meaning in those words.
More importantly...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Her voice... was trembling.
She seemed deeply unsettled mentally.
Perhaps she's in a rather bad way...

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Nature, if you're that worried,
let's go see her!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Huh? Go see who... Teio?

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text: Yeah! Even if she can't participate in races, she should still be coming to Tracen Academy.

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text: Teio! Haaay, Teio!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Ah, Turbo!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Twin Turbo called Tokai Teio out, and then—

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Thanks for waiting. Sorry,
it took a little longer than expected.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Teio...?

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text: Tokai... Teio...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Tokai Teio is...

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Heave... ho. Heave... ho...

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
It's nothing serious, really.
Just gotta wear this for a little while.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
They're being so dramatic.
I never needed a cane before.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Her painful-looking state left everyone at a loss for words.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: I wonder if Teio's really going to be all right.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Didn't they seem like they were having a harder time than before?

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: "Seeing Teio look like that... when she's supposed to be more cheerful than anyone... it just doesn't suit her..."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: The gap in appearances seemed to rattle Nice Nature even more, but...

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text: Nature. Teio is gonna be fine.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Turbo? Why do you think that?
You saw it too, right?

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Seeing that... did you not feel anything at all?

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text: Sure, it looked rough, but you don't need to worry about a little cane like that!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Teio will come back. She'll definitely come back.
Because she's Tokai Teio.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Turbo...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: The absolute clarity of those words was almost like—

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Teio isn't just fast.
She's an Umamusume who'll
never, ever stay down no matter what.

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
No matter how many times she gets hurt, she won't stay down.
I'm sure she's already looking for training she can do and taking action.

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
If you sit around worrying, they'll turn the tables and beat you!
That! That right there is what it's all about!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Tokai Teio!
Because she's Turbo's arch-rival for life!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Turbo, you...

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha, it's like some of Teio's sparkle
rubbed off on you.

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Yeah! Turbo doesn't wanna lose!
Not even to Teio in staying positive!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Her cheerful demeanor was a saving grace. To be honest, there was no telling what the future held for Tokai Teio.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Even so, I had to do what I could.
All I could do was focus on the future."

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Alright Trainer. The showdown got put on hold for a bit,
but this is our chance!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Both Teio and Nature are taking a break!
Turbo needs to get waaaay stronger in the meantime.
Before autumn comes!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
This was undeniably a major advantage.
Over the course of this summer, completely bridging the gap in talent...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Come autumn and winter, I wanted to show off
the perfected 'Twin Turbo Style Running.'

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, what's Turbo's next goal?
Maybe the Takarazuka Kinen in place of Teio?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: I shake my head. What Twin Turbo should be aiming for isn't a GⅠ title, but a run where she can burn completely bright and give it everything she's got.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"To do that, I want to hone my front-runner style to perfection
on the racecourse that suits it best.
Which means—"
choice_data_list: Let's go for the Tanabata Sho at Fukushima.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: "Tanabata Sho"... Huh, we're going for a GⅢ? You really have a unique approach, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text: Even if it's unique, Trainer understands Turbo best of all!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
All right! To really show Tokai Teio what I've got,
the Tanabata Sho will be...

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Let's definitely win this!
Sounds good, right, Trainer?
choice_data_list: Yeah, let's go at it aggressively!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
For Twin Turbo to grow even stronger, she needs
further resolve. For a GIII race, aiming for nothing
less than absolute victory is just right.

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Fufun, then this summer in my beloved Fukushima,
I'm gonna go totally wild. Just you watch, Teio!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The decisive battle—has been postponed.
Twin Turbo, however, didn't mind in the slightest.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Head straight forward solely to grow stronger,
heading toward the Tanabata Sho."
